symbiont-mediated perturbation of host protein ubiquitination

definition: A process by which a symbiont alters ubiquitin-like protein modification of target proteins of either host or symbiont proteins. This includes ubiquitination, SUMOylation, NEDDylation, and ISG15ylation. The ubiquitination status of a protein  affects whether it is targeted to the proteasome for degradation. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host ubiquitin-like protein modification
